name: Gudbrand
description: A well-meaning hillside farmer who keeps making practical-seeming trades all the way home, trusting he can explain it later.
visualPrompt: A Norwegian rural man in his 30s–40s wearing worn work boots, jeans, and a fleece jacket, weather-reddened face, kind eyes, slightly sheepish expression, hands rough from farm work

name: Gudbrand’s Wife
description: Steady, good-natured, and fiercely supportive; she reframes every trade as the smartest possible choice.
visualPrompt: A Norwegian rural woman in her 30s–40s with practical tied-back hair, simple sweater and apron, calm smiling expression, confident posture in a warm kitchen setting

name: The Neighbor
description: A skeptical onlooker who wagers savings that Gudbrand’s wife will finally get angry—and loses.
visualPrompt: A middle-aged neighbor in a knit cap and work jacket, curious and doubtful expression, standing just outside a farmhouse door in the evening

name: The Trader Teen
description: A local teen eager to offload a too-noisy rooster, accidentally becoming the final link in Gudbrand’s trading chain.
visualPrompt: A teenager in a hoodie and sneakers holding a cardboard box with a rooster inside, amused and casual, standing by a roadside in a rural area
